# Light

Card type `custom:houseview-light-card`, or `type: light` in the `cards` list of `custom:houseview-card`. Available since 1.0.

Shows a `light.*` entity as an icon widget with its name and state. The widget is highlighted while the light is `on`.
Tap the tile to toggle on/off. With the default `action: view`, the icon is a brightness key that opens the full-screen
light view (drag up or down to dim, or use its keyboard-accessible slider); holding the tile opens the same view.
With `action: toggle` a tap toggles the light (`light.toggle`); with `action: off` a tap always calls `light.turn_off`,
which suits "everything off" and bedtime widgets. Those two actions have no brightness key or hold. An unavailable or
unknown light is shown disabled.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity | entity | required | A `light.*` entity |
| name | string | friendly name | Label |
| size | normal/wide/tall/large | normal | Widget size on carousel pages |
| icon | icon | `mdi:lightbulb-outline` | Override the icon. A name without a prefix is an `mdi:` icon |
| action | view/toggle/off | view | `view` toggles on tap and opens brightness from the icon (or a hold); `toggle` flips the light; `off` always turns it off. Unquoted YAML `off` is accepted |

```yaml
type: custom:houseview-light-card
entity: light.living_room
action: off
```
